page.summary: Anchor repair around a selected generator and a useful Boon zone, then release the location when setup, snuffing or Killer pressure makes the commitment lose value.

verdict.recommendation: Choose the target generator and totem position first; this provisional plan is a local repair zone, not a map-wide promise.
verdict.soloQ: Call or visibly establish the target before blessing, and rotate when the zone is no longer the team's useful objective.
verdict.coordinatedSwf: Assign who repairs, who watches the zone and who calls the handoff when the Killer contests or snuffs it.
verdict.mainWeakness: Totem setup and location, Killer snuffing or destruction, and locality can remove the value before the team repays the setup time.

plans.label: Boon repair-zone tools
plans.why: Anchor the module to one Boon zone; remaining slots stay open because the source does not establish a fixed build.

choices.whyItsHere: Create the source-defined local repair zone around a generator worth defending.
Choose this only when an active Boon makes faster future blessing or nearby objective information repay the extra slot; do not assume it speeds the first setup or a post-snuff rebuild.

soloQ: Do not expect teammates to infer the target generator; use the zone while it is useful, then return to ordinary repair or rescue work.
coordinatedSwf: Call the target, keep repair assignments inside the useful zone and name the next job when the totem is contested or lost.

weaknesses: The strategy is exposed to totem location, snuffing and the cost of defending a local zone that the team has abandoned.
killerCounterplay: The Killer can contest the location, snuff the Boon or force the team away from the selected generator.
commonMistakes: Blessing a convenient totem without checking whether its zone supports the next generator rotation.
Keeping teammates on a denied zone after the Killer has made the location unsafe.
Treating a provisional local plan as a fixed repair assignment after its setup resource is gone.

opening: Before blessing, identify a generator the team can defend and a totem position whose zone will remain useful after the first repair rotation.

rows.situation: A target generator and a reachable totem can form a useful local zone.
rows.action: Bless there, call the target and begin work only while the zone helps the team's next repair rotation.
rows.why: The strategy is spatially anchored; a boon in an irrelevant corner is not objective value.

rows.situation: The zone is active and teammates are using the target generator.
rows.action: Keep the team on the defended work while checking whether the Killer is about to contest or snuff the totem.
rows.why: Maintenance is a location and assignment decision, not a map-wide repair bonus.

rows.situation: The totem is snuffed, the target is abandoned or the Killer makes the location unsafe.
rows.action: Stop defending the old zone and rotate to the next useful generator or ordinary objective job.
rows.why: The provisional plan must release the locality when its setup no longer returns team tempo.

abortWhen: Abort the setup when the chosen totem position cannot support a useful generator route.
Leave the zone when it is snuffed or the Killer has made its location a losing commitment.

mechanics.explanation: The repair benefit is local to the active Boon zone; choose a generator and totem position that the team can continue to use.
